name: todoist
description: Connect Todoist to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Todoist MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Todoist to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with tasks, projects and reminders using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Todoist workspace.
Find anything in Todoist that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review tasks, projects and reminders in Todoist.
